title: Circit canonical agent-event v1
description: Single SSE event protocol the Circit-branded SPA consumes. BOTH runtimes normalize into this: the .NET AgentCore Host (10 AgentEventType frames, streams today) and Odysseus (~28 SSE types + 10 ui_event control verbs). The edge normalizer maps each native frame to one canonical 'kind' or drops it. v1 constraint: a single run does not mix runtimes mid-conversation; correlationId links a cowork task to an Odysseus session for a unified transcript + audit.

schemaVersion.description: Canonical schema major version. Bump on breaking change.

kind.description: Normalized event kind. Closed enum — every native frame maps to one of these or is dropped at the edge.

id.description: Per-event unique id (native event id or a freshly minted one).

correlationId.description: Links every event of a logical run across runtimes. cowork taskId or Odysseus sessionId.

source.description: Which backend produced the native frame this was normalized from.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-stream ordering hint set by the edge.

timestamp.description: Event time (ISO-8601). Edge fills if the native frame lacks one.

summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary. May be empty for pure deltas.

actor.description: The authenticated caller this event is attributed to (from the gateway assertion). Null only for legacy/unscoped events pre-P1.2.

data.description: Kind-specific payload. Shapes for tool.result / subagent.* finalize in P4.1; v1 carries them through opaquely.
